scope: Injected DOM/media/detector integration; not browser rendering or real model inference

checks.name: Startup requests neither camera nor models
Mirror start requests front-camera video without audio
Mirror start automatically loads requested object recognition
Live pixels use the display raster rather than the analysis raster
Mirror canvas and label projection share the reflection
Scene reports the actual injected observed class
Clicking a label opens evidence-bound details
Displayed model score is not tracking decay
World switch requests a rear camera and releases the old stream
World image and labels are not mirrored
Labels off removes annotations and unloads recognition
Lost detections remove camera labels and scene context
Glasses preview exposes no companion annotation elements
Stop releases media tracks and clears the scene
Denied permission falls back with explicit synthetic provenance
Recognition failure preserves the camera and reports the error
Hiding the page releases the camera
